purpose: Define auditable vehicle telemetry evidence for Issue #45 powered commissioning and future lifecycle/range analysis without granting controller or operation authority.

record_format.monotonic_clock_rule: mono_us is the primary ordering clock; UTC is session metadata only and must never be used for control timing.

integrity_policy.interpretation: These are commissioning evidence-quality thresholds, not control-loop timing or safety limits.

derived_signal_rules.longitudinal_jerk_mps3: Must declare the acceleration source, filter/derivative method and method reference. No unqualified raw finite-difference jerk is accepted as Stage 4 evidence.
derived_signal_rules.ground_speed_mps: Must identify independent ground-speed source or the exact qualified fusion method.
derived_signal_rules.odometer_km: May enter lifecycle service calculations only after its accumulation/reset behavior is independently qualified.
derived_signal_rules.ride_hours: May enter lifecycle service calculations only after its active-time definition and reset behavior are independently qualified.

logger_architecture_rules: telemetry persistence must not block or delay the real-time control loop
control behavior must fail conservative if required sensors are stale even if logging is unavailable
logging failure invalidates evidence for a stage that requires the missing data but must not preserve propulsion
persistent storage writes should be buffered outside the hard real-time control path
session metadata must record logger firmware/build identity and signal-source mapping
raw/source channels must remain distinguishable from derived channels
fault bit changes must be reconstructable from periodic control_fault_bits and matching fault-edge events
hard_boundaries: valid telemetry evidence grants no powered-operation authority
valid telemetry evidence grants no controller-configuration authority
valid telemetry evidence grants no battery-configuration authority
valid telemetry evidence grants no public-operation authority
valid telemetry evidence grants no dog-accompanied-operation authority
telemetry cannot replace independent mechanical braking or lifecycle preflight
exact ride and commissioning logs remain private
